name: zelda-ocarina-developers-interview-ask-the-developer-24
lines:
أونوما عن نقاط الانتقال:
اقترحتها لكنها لم تنجح معي
فطلبت من الفريق حذفها

قال فوجيباياشي: من المهم
تحديد ما نغيّره وما نتركه
بوضوح منذ البداية
headline:
حوار جديد من 4 أجزاء
عن Ocarina of Time
label: حوار
lowres_ok: Nintendo's Switch 2 store trailers (US nsuid 70010000130792, 1280x720, three videos) are the only official copies; Nintendo's YouTube channel is not reachable here (sign-in wall) and no 1080p press-kit file is public
note: Primary: Nintendo, Ask the Developer Vol. 24 (four chapters; Chapters 1 and 2 published 2 Nov). Reel v5 after Mohammad's comments: story framed as the new four-part interview, tidbits not a translation; footage Overview Trailer 188.2 to 211.4 s, the stretch with no narration (whisper: speech ends 186.7 s, resumes 214.8 s); fixed horizontal crops (no autofocus pan); the Triforce shot centred on the triforce; series intro «باقي 3 أيام» joined ahead.
